name: Addo Elephant National Park
blurb: Addo Elephant National Park in South Africa is known for sightings of elephants, rhinos, and diverse bird species. Located in the Eastern Cape near Gqeberha, the park features conservation areas, waterholes, and wildlife viewing opportunities.

positive: High chance of seeing elephants and other wildlife
Great spot for photography and game drives
negative: Wetlands in the park are reported to be in danger
Visits can be disrupted by high winds preventing docking or travel

quotes.text: New visitors always want to know what they can expect to see in the Addo Elephant Park. It is really not possible to make guarantees, but I usually say there’s a 95% chance of seeing elephants on a day visit.
